question: Will the South Bridge reopen this week, yes or no?

lines.text: Two drones hit Kyiv's metro bridge.
Kyiv's mayor says two drones struck near the supports of the Pivdennyi, or South, Bridge this morning.
UNITED24 reports a metro train was crossing, and smoke filled one carriage.
lines.note: UNITED24; Kyiv Post says early train reports are unverified

lines.text: The train reached Vydubychi station. No injuries were reported.
Klitschko says metro and surface public transport across the bridge have now been suspended.

scene.quote: Metro and surface public transport across the bridge have now been suspended.

lines.text: The Green metro line now stops at Vydubychi, Interfax-Ukraine says.
The bridge is over a kilometre long, carrying the metro and six lanes over the Dnipro.
City engineers are inspecting it now.
Earlier, a drone hit a Kyiv school. Zelensky says the children were in a shelter, and no one was hurt.
lines.note: Zelensky on X, via Kyiv Independent and Reuters

lines.text: A presidential adviser says Russia used a new jet drone warhead on Wednesday, built for pylons and steel bridges.
lines.note: Serhiy Beskrestnov ("Flash") on Telegram, via Kyiv Post

lines.text: That day, one Kyiv air raid alert lasted twelve hours and forty four minutes.
lines.note: Kyiv Independent: one of the longest of the full-scale war

scene.label: one air raid alert, Wed 30 Sep
scene.detail: one of the longest of the war

lines.text: Russia has stepped up jet drone attacks on Kyiv since late August, the Kyiv Independent says.

caption: Kyiv's Pivdennyi Bridge: two Russian drones struck near the supports of the South Bridge, and reports say a metro train was crossing. Metro and road traffic across it are suspended while engineers inspect it. Will the South Bridge reopen this week, yes or no?
notes_full: Strike about 11:30 Kyiv time (08:30 UTC) 1 Oct 2026; first reports about 09:15 UTC; Kyiv Independent, Kyiv Post, UNITED24, Interfax-Ukraine, Ukrainska Pravda, UNN, Censor.net
Klitschko: two UAV strikes near the support section of the Pivdennyi Bridge; metro and surface public transport suspended
UNITED24: Shahed-type drone, smoke and ash in a carriage, shattered windows, train continued to Vydubychi, no injuries reported; Kyiv Post says train claims unverified
Interfax-Ukraine: Green (M3) line runs Syrets to Vydubychi only
Bridge: 1,256 m, 135 m pylon, opened 25 Dec 1990, metro + 6 lanes (Wikipedia)
School in Solomianskyi hit earlier; children and teachers sheltering, no injuries (Zelensky, Reuters)
Beskrestnov: shaped-charge cutting warhead on a jet drone used 30 Sep for the first time, 40 kg main charge, designed for high-voltage pylons and steel bridge structures (Kyiv Post)
Left out: overnight death toll across Ukraine, Zelensky 'scumbags' quote
